verdict.rationale: Handling legal service of process separately from ordinary mail, with distinct delivery commitments, is a core question for a registered-agent provider, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no page content at all. The only items are probes showing the www.wolterskluwer.com host is behind a Cloudflare challenge and that the legacy CT host redirects into it, so nothing documents separate service-of-process handling or delivery commitments.
